_derivation.values_and_sections: unchanged. Nothing between the datagen read and the window advances FakeClock (the extra read is instant), so the loop schedule, rounds, maintenance, settle (870 s), window and every score are as continuous_c360. skip_generate is read nowhere else in _run_sustained (grep: lines 2846, 2863, 2864, 2973 only), and the fleet rows that size the settle come from collect_from_k8s, not from the deploy. exit_code, unscripted, runs_saved, exported_run_id, submits, journal_events, metrics_keys, jobs, maintenance_outcomes, values, c360_correctness, success, verdict, verdict_reasons, continuous, streaming, benchmark_rounds and continuous_scores are byte-for-byte continuous_c360's.
_derivation.differs_from_record: As continuous_c360's differs_from_record (settle 870.0 s vs 874.1, total_s3_objects 300 vs 12320, constant gold event age, throughput over exactly 1800.0 s, round and skip times, window start .500). In addition the record deployed datagen itself (no --skip-generate) and cleared the raw prefix; this scenario does neither and replays the record's fleet as if a finished datagen Job wrote it.
_derivation.unsure: Nothing material. The only judgement is that a 'finished' datagen Job makes run() pass datagen_runs=False to the prerequisites, which the code states directly (cli/_run.py:1844).

_derivation.rerecord_cd17: CD-17 (lane/v17-run-cd16, stacked on CD-16): 82 CoreV1Api read_namespace runchar calls added, by hand from the loop_schedule above and the settle record, not from the harness. NamespaceWatch.start() reads the namespace once after stream_identities (the window start); check() reads it after every loop sleep before the health line, at the top of every benchmark, maintenance and compaction round that runs, right after every benchmark round (the loop continues without a sleep), after every settle poll's sleep, and once before the by-name stream stop (cli/_sustained.py). In the window, from the schedule: start + 10 health probes (30..300) + round-1 probe before round 1; after-round-1 probe + 6 health probes (466.5..600) + maintenance-1 probe before maintenance 1; 5 (630..736.5) + round-2 probe before round 2; after-round-2 probe + 10 (898.1..1168.1) + round-3 probe before round 3; after-round-3 probe + maintenance-2 probe (the 1326.1 iteration) before maintenance 2; the compaction probe before compaction; 11 health probes (1519.1..1626.1, 1656.1..1776.1, 1800.0) before the window-end get_job_status: 52. The round due at 1626.1 is skipped (late) and gets no probe. Settle (continuous.settle.seconds 870, 30 s polls): 30 polls of three driver-log reads, a probe after each of the 29 sleeps, i.e. before every poll but the first: 29. One before the three delete_custom_resource of _stop_streams. Nothing else moves. Re-derived the same way on train/1002-j 5bcee1b4: ER-10's start sample comes before the window, and its end sample and ER-9h's three corpus-observation calls come after the result check, outside every window and settle segment, so the 82 reads land at the same places relative to the window and settle calls.
